name: WF12 Publish To Platforms
description: Atomically claims due publishing jobs and runs resumable YouTube, Facebook Reel, Instagram Reel, or TikTok draft/inbox provider stages. Provider IDs and polling checkpoints are persisted before advancing so asynchronous acknowledgements are never mistaken for a completed publication. Opt-in POSTIZ jobs use a durable single-attempt handoff and identity-checked status reconciliation; existing DIRECT jobs keep their provider route.

parameters.query:
WITH existing_claim AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT jobs.*
  FROM short_videos.publishing_jobs AS jobs
  WHERE jobs.claimed_by = $1
    AND jobs.publish_status IN ('CLAIMED', 'UPLOADING')
    AND jobs.lease_expires_at > now()
  ORDER BY jobs.claimed_at, jobs.publish_id
  LIMIT 1
), candidate AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT jobs.publish_id
  FROM short_videos.publishing_jobs AS jobs
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_claim)
    AND (jobs.scheduled_at IS NULL OR jobs.scheduled_at <= now())
    AND (
      jobs.publish_status = 'PENDING'
      OR (
        jobs.publish_status = 'RETRY_PENDING'
        AND jobs.retry_count < 4
        AND (jobs.next_retry_at IS NULL OR jobs.next_retry_at <= now())
      )
      OR (
        jobs.publish_status = 'PROCESSING'
        AND (jobs.poll_after IS NULL OR jobs.poll_after <= now())
      )
      OR (
        jobs.publish_status IN ('CLAIMED', 'UPLOADING')
        AND COALESCE(
          jobs.lease_expires_at,
          jobs.claimed_at + interval '30 minutes',
          jobs.started_at + interval '30 minutes',
          jobs.updated_at + interval '30 minutes'
        ) <= now()
      )
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN jobs.publish_status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    COALESCE(jobs.poll_after, jobs.scheduled_at, jobs.created_at),
    jobs.created_at,
    jobs.publish_id
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LIMIT 1
), new_claim AS (
  UPDATE short_videos.publishing_jobs AS jobs
  SET publish_status = 'CLAIMED',
      claimed_at = now(),
      claimed_by = $1,
      lease_expires_at = now() + ($2::integer * interval '1 minute'),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM candidate
  WHERE jobs.publish_id = candidate.publish_id
  RETURNING jobs.*
)
SELECT * FROM existing_claim
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM new_claim
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE short_videos.publishing_jobs
SET publish_status = 'UPLOADING',
    started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()),
    updated_at = now()
WHERE publish_id = $1
  AND claimed_by = $2
  AND publish_status IN ('CLAIMED', 'UPLOADING')
  AND lease_expires_at > now()
RETURNING *;

UPDATE short_videos.publishing_jobs
SET publish_status = CASE
      WHEN provider_poll_count + 1 >= 180
        OR COALESCE(provider_poll_deadline, now() + interval '24 hours') <= now()
      THEN 'FAILED'
      ELSE 'PROCESSING'
    END,
    provider_stage = $3,
    provider_ref = CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim($4), '') IS NULL THEN provider_ref ELSE $4 END,
    provider_response = CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim($5), '') IS NULL THEN provider_response ELSE $5::jsonb END,
    poll_after = CASE
      WHEN provider_poll_count + 1 >= 180
        OR COALESCE(provider_poll_deadline, now() + interval '24 hours') <= now()
      THEN NULL
      ELSE now() + ($6::integer * interval '1 minute')
    END,
    provider_poll_count = provider_poll_count + 1,
    provider_poll_deadline = COALESCE(provider_poll_deadline, now() + interval '24 hours'),
    last_error = CASE
      WHEN provider_poll_count + 1 >= 180
        OR COALESCE(provider_poll_deadline, now() + interval '24 hours') <= now()
      THEN 'PROVIDER_POLL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: manual reconciliation required'
      ELSE last_error
    END,
    claimed_at = NULL,
    claimed_by = NULL,
    lease_expires_at = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE publish_id = $1
  AND claimed_by = $2
  AND publish_status = 'UPLOADING'
  AND (publishing_backend = 'DIRECT' OR (
    lease_expires_at > now()
    AND provider_stage = 'POSTIZ_SUBMITTED'
    AND $3 = 'POSTIZ_SUBMITTED'
    AND postiz_post_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $4 = postiz_post_id
  ))
RETURNING *;

UPDATE short_videos.publishing_jobs
SET publish_status = $3,
    post_id = $4,
    post_url = $5,
    provider_stage = $6,
    provider_response = CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim($7), '') IS NULL THEN provider_response ELSE $7::jsonb END,
    completed_at = now(),
    next_retry_at = NULL,
    poll_after = NULL,
    provider_poll_count = 0,
    provider_poll_deadline = NULL,
    last_error = NULL,
    claimed_at = NULL,
    claimed_by = NULL,
    lease_expires_at = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE publish_id = $1
  AND claimed_by = $2
  AND publish_status = 'UPLOADING'
  AND publishing_backend = 'DIRECT'
  AND $3 IN ('PUBLISHED', 'DRAFT_UPLOADED')
  AND (
    NULLIF($4, '') IS NOT NULL
    OR (platform = 'TIKTOK' AND NULLIF(provider_ref, '') IS NOT NULL)
  )
RETURNING *;

UPDATE short_videos.publishing_jobs
SET publish_status = CASE
      WHEN publishing_backend = 'POSTIZ' AND postiz_submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND $3 = 'RETRY_PENDING' THEN 'FAILED'
      ELSE $3
    END,
    retry_count = $4::integer,
    next_retry_at = CASE WHEN publishing_backend = 'POSTIZ' AND postiz_submitted_at IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF($5, '')::timestamptz END,
    last_error = CASE
      WHEN publishing_backend = 'POSTIZ' AND postiz_submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND $3 = 'RETRY_PENDING' THEN 'POSTIZ_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: ' || $6
      ELSE $6
    END,
    provider_response = CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim($7), '') IS NULL THEN provider_response ELSE $7::jsonb END,
    poll_after = NULL,
    provider_poll_deadline = NULL,
    claimed_at = NULL,
    claimed_by = NULL,
    lease_expires_at = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE publish_id = $1
  AND claimed_by = $2
  AND publish_status = 'UPLOADING'
  AND (publishing_backend = 'DIRECT' OR lease_expires_at > now())
  AND $3 IN ('RETRY_PENDING', 'AUTH_REQUIRED', 'REJECTED', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED')
RETURNING *;

parameters.query:
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE short_videos.publishing_jobs
  SET publish_status = 'SKIPPED',
      destination_id = $3,
      last_error = $4,
      next_retry_at = NULL,
      claimed_at = NULL,
      claimed_by = NULL,
      lease_expires_at = NULL,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE publish_id = $1
    AND claimed_by = $2
    AND publish_status = 'UPLOADING'
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT * FROM updated
UNION ALL
SELECT jobs.*
FROM short_videos.publishing_jobs AS jobs
WHERE jobs.publish_id = $1
  AND jobs.publish_status = 'SKIPPED'
  AND jobs.destination_id = $3
  AND jobs.last_error = $4
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
-- Intentionally returns no row on replay: only the winning transition may POST.
UPDATE short_videos.publishing_jobs
SET provider_stage = 'POSTIZ_SUBMIT_REQUESTED',
    postiz_submit_payload = $3::jsonb,
    postiz_submitted_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
WHERE publish_id = $1
  AND claimed_by = $2
  AND publish_status = 'UPLOADING'
  AND lease_expires_at > now()
  AND publishing_backend = 'POSTIZ'
  AND provider_stage = 'POSTIZ_MEDIA_READY'
  AND postiz_post_id IS NULL
  AND postiz_submitted_at IS NULL
  AND postiz_media_id IS NOT NULL AND postiz_media_path IS NOT NULL
  AND jsonb_typeof($3::jsonb) = 'object'
  AND $3::jsonb <> '{}'::jsonb
  AND $3::jsonb->>'type' = 'now'
  AND jsonb_typeof($3::jsonb->'posts') = 'array'
  AND jsonb_array_length($3::jsonb->'posts') = 1
  AND $3::jsonb #>> '{posts,0,integration,id}' = postiz_integration_id
  AND $3::jsonb #>> '{posts,0,value,0,image,0,id}' = postiz_media_id
  AND $3::jsonb #>> '{posts,0,value,0,image,0,path}' = postiz_media_path
RETURNING *;
